moments.text: IR view of bright puffy clouds against grey sky, with an orange crosshair and corner marks; the view drifts across the cloud tops.
Half a second of blank grey and black frames, then a hazy close-up inside cloud, darker toward the bottom.
A small white dash enters at the left edge, passes just above the crosshair and leaves the right edge in 1.2 s; use frame step.
The sensor swings and changes zoom through dark and bright cloud masses, then black and grey frames at 14.4 s.
Wide view of large cumulus clouds; from 17.5 s a big black masking shape covers the upper right of the frame until 22.5 s.
A tiny white dot appears left of centre and settles just left of the crosshair; clouds slide past behind it and often hide it.
Zoom in on cloud with a box around the crosshair; the tiny dot sits just outside the box's lower-right corner, drifts right, then back.
The dot returns to just below the crosshair and stays there, slightly left, as clouds stream past right to left behind it.
Closer view of rippled sea and cloud: a white oval runs along the bottom, left to right, under 1 s, into the lower-right black box.
The sensor keeps looking down at rippled sea as cloud banks drift through, then the clip ends on black frames.
